The explicit server membership/spectator rule is unresolved: identical pinned handlers accept caller-supplied playerId and validate occupied seat metadata, without a traced caller-to-seat credential check. No exploit or live server test was performed.
rationale: The checked task group and normal-path tests substantiate most behavior but do not establish the specified spectator prohibition under server-side membership validation. This is an unresolved acceptance criterion, not a claim of abandonment or a demonstrated exploit.

Catalog changes emotes to common scope and tests explicitly assert availability across DiceThrone and SmashUp.
